<!-- This code has been partially generated by an AI. -->

Confirms the current release is running inside GitHub Actions. Works seamlessly on `github.com`, **GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES)**, and **GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency (`*.ghe.com`)**.

## Installation

### Binary

```bash
semrel plugin install @semrel/condition-github-actions
```

`semrel plugin install` downloads the binary to `.semrel/plugins/` and updates `.semrel.lock`. Commit `.semrel.lock` to pin the version for your team.


### Docker

Pre-built, signed multi-platform images (linux/amd64, linux/arm64) are published on every release:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/semrels/condition-github-actions:latest
```

Verify the image signature with cosign:

```bash
cosign verify ghcr.io/semrels/condition-github-actions:latest \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/SemRels/condition-github-actions/.github/workflows/release.yml.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```
## Configuration

```yaml
version: 1
plugins:
  - uses: @semrel/condition-github-actions
    phase: condition
    args:
      branch: main
```

## Environment Variables

| Name | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_BRANCH` | no | `—` | Optional branch name override. When set, requires `GITHUB_REF_NAME` (or `GITHUB_REF` stripped of `refs/heads/`) to match this value. |

## GitHub Actions & Enterprise Environment

| Variable | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GITHUB_ACTIONS` | yes | Must be `"true"`. |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN` | yes | At least one token variable must be non-empty. |
| `GITHUB_REF_NAME` / `GITHUB_REF` | no | Checked when `SEMREL_PLUGIN_BRANCH` is set; automatically falls back to `GITHUB_REF` (`refs/heads/<branch>`) on older GHES runners. |
| `GITHUB_SERVER_URL` | no | Optional GitHub server URL (e.g. `https://github.com`, `https://ghe.example.com`, or `https://octocorp.ghe.com`). Validated as an `http`/`https` URL when set. |
| `GITHUB_API_URL` | no | Optional GitHub API URL (e.g. `https://api.github.com`, `https://ghe.example.com/api/v3`, or `https://api.octocorp.ghe.com`). Validated as an `http`/`https` URL when set. |

## Release Context Variables

This plugin does not require any of the shared `SEMREL_*` release context variables to do its job.

## Behavior

When `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` and a valid token + URL environment is present, the plugin succeeds immediately. Otherwise the condition fails and SemRel stops the pipeline.
